verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat and collaboration product, so per-channel, keyword, and schedule notification tuning is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no notification preferences, keyword alerts, or do-not-disturb schedules. The only nearby items are a vision-level "Personalized feed" line and a benchmark grading which users an agent's reply notifies. Both are adjacent features and do not deliver user-configurable notification controls.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can tune notifications per channel, keyword, and schedule so only what matters interrupts me
